book.name: 1Qorontoose Asaas
book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoose Asaas Xaafida Koyro Kiita

content: Isra7eele Nayta Bolla Gakkidayssi Gakkontta Mala Naageteth
Ta ishatoo! Kase nu Aawati shaaray isttafe bollara gididi kaaleththidayssa malanne istti wurikka zo7o abba pinnidayssa ta inttena qofsanaas koyays.
Istti Musera gidanaas giidi shaaraninne abban xammaqettida.
Wurikka issi ayana quma mida.
Wurikka issi ayana ushshu uyida; istti uyidaykka bana kaalliza ayana zaallafe pulttidayssafe; he zaallayka Kirstoosa.
Gido attiin Xoossi darotan ufayettibeenna; hessa gishshas istta ahay bazzon kundi attides.
Istti iita miish amottidayssaththo nunikka amottontta mala istta hanoy nu naagettana mala nuus leemiso gidides.
«Derey maanaassinne uyanaas uttides; yexxanaaska dendides» geetetti kase Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettida mala istta garsafe issi issi asati ooththoyssaththo intteka eeqa goynnizayta gidopite.
Istta garsafe issi issi asati laymatidi issi gallas 23,000 asay dippi gi wuroyssaththo wurontta mala nunikka ane laymatokko.
Istta garsafe issi issi asati Godaa paaccidi shooshshan duketti hayqqi dhaydayssa mala nunikka ane Godaa paaccoko.
Istta garsafe issi issi asati zuuzumidi dhayssiza bosha kiitanchchan dhaydayssaththo intteka dhayontta mala zuuzumopite.
Hessi wuri nuus leemiso gidana mala istta bolla gakkides; wode wurseththan diza nuus timirte gidana mala nuus xaafettides.
Hessa gishshas ta minna eqqa days gizaadey diikko kundontta mala baas naagetto.

Asa bolla gakkida paaceppe hara aadhdhiza paacey intte bolla gakkibeenna; Xoossi ammanettiza Xoos gidida gishshas intte dandayontta intte wolqqafe bollara intte paacettenna mala izi inttena aggaagenna; gido attiin intte paacettiza wode he paaceza intte dandayana mala wolqqa immidi paaceppe intte kessi ekkana oge izi inttes giigsana.
Eeqara Issifeteththi Daanaas Bessenna
Hessa gishshas ta siiqotoo! Eeqas goynnofte; izappe haakkite.
Ta inttes hayssa gizay wozinama gidida gishshassa; hessa gishshas ta yootizayssa ane intte intterkka pirdite.
Nuni Xoossa galatidi ekkiza ushshay Kirstoosa suuththara gaagoteththi dizayssa gidennee? Hessaththoka nu baththi baththi gishetti miza ukeththay Kirstoosa ashora gaagoteththi dizayssa gidennee?
Ukeththay issino gidida mala nunikka daro gidi uttidi wurikka issi asho; nu wurikka issi ukeththaza gishetti moos.
Ane intte Isra7eele nayti ooththidayssa qopite; shiiqiza yarshozappe mizaytas yarshoy shiiqizasora gaagoteththi deennee?
Histtiin eeqas yarshettida yarsho gidiin woykko eeqay ba baggara go7ara dees gazinaa?
Gidenna! Ammanontta asay shiishshiza yarshoy Xoossas gidontta Xala7essa; inttes Xala7era issifeteththi daana mala ta koykke.
Xala7e ushshinne Godaa ushshu intte issife gaththi uyana dandayekketa; Godaa maaddafenne Xala7e maaddafe gaththi maana dandayekketa.
Nuni Godaa hanqeththinoo? Nu izappe minnizonii?
Ubbaaka Xoossa Bonchchos Ooso
Wurikka taas imettides shin wurikka tana go7izaaz gidenna; wurikka taassa shin wurikka tana maaddenna.
Asi wurikka ba lagge go7anaaz gaththi xeello attiin bana go7anaaz xalala koyoppo.
Giyan bayzettiza asho ubbaa sidhey baynda miite.
Biittaynne biitta bolla dizay wurikka Godayssa.
Ammanontta asi inttena baso xeygidi shiishshida kath wursi aykkoka sidhontta miite.
Gido attiin issaadey, «Hayssi eeqas yarshettida kaththa» giikko he kaththaa he addeza qofaa gishshassinne inttena sidhiskko moopite.
Ta inttes hessa gizay he yootidaade qofaa gishshas gadis attiin intte qofaa gishshas gabeekke; ta xillo gida dishin aazas hara asa qofaa gaason ta bolla pirdettizee?
Ta Xoos galatada mizaade gida uttada aazas hara asan pirdettoo?
Histtiko intte ay miikkoka, ay uyikkoka woykko aykko ooththiko wursika Xoossa bonchchos ooththite.
Ayhuda asaas gidiin Ayzaabetas gidiin woykko Xoossa Woosa Keeththas oonaska dhuphe gidopite.
Ta as wursaka ay ogerakka ufayssana koyza mala intteka hessaththo ooththite; daroti attana mala ta tana go7izaaz gidontta istta go7izaaz koyays.
